name: Experimental Design
description: Turn a scientific question into a rigorous, bias-resistant, reproducible experiment and analysis plan before data collection.

tasks.name: Specify question and estimand
tasks.objective: Define hypothesis or objective, target population/system, intervention/exposure, outcome, estimand, unit of analysis, meaningful effect, and decision threshold.

tasks.name: Map bias and confounding
tasks.objective: Identify confounders, selection effects, measurement error, batch effects, leakage, researcher degrees of freedom, and threats to internal/external validity.

tasks.name: Design controls and assignment
tasks.objective: Choose comparison groups, randomization, blocking/stratification, masking/blinding, replication, counterbalancing, inclusion/exclusion, and stopping rules appropriate to the system.

tasks.name: Plan sample and precision
tasks.objective: Set sample size or measurement effort from effect/precision targets, variability assumptions, attrition/missingness, multiplicity, clustering, and practical constraints; record sensitivity to assumptions.

tasks.name: Predefine analysis
tasks.objective: Specify preprocessing, primary/secondary outcomes, statistical models, diagnostics, missing-data handling, multiplicity, exclusions, robustness and sensitivity analyses before outcome inspection.

tasks.name: Build reproducibility package
tasks.objective: Define protocol, materials/data provenance, environment, random seeds, code/versioning, instrument calibration, metadata, audit trail, preregistration where appropriate, and independent reproduction path.

tasks.name: Adversarial design review
tasks.objective: Attempt to invalidate the proposed inference through alternative causal paths, unmeasured confounding, underpowered contrasts, pseudoreplication, leakage, non-identifiability, and ambiguous measurement before data collection begins.
